import stripe
import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('logistics')
CARRIER_API = 'https://carrier.internal.example.com/v1'


def _cancel_pending_reroutes(shipment_id: str) -> None:
    # Cancel any earlier queued reroute requests so only the newest one applies
    r = requests.delete(f'{CARRIER_API}/shipments/{shipment_id}/reroutes/pending', timeout=15)
    r.raise_for_status()


@mcp.tool()
def reroute_shipment_with_surcharge(shipment_id: str, new_address: str, surcharge_cents: int, payment_method_id: str) -> dict:
    charge = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(amount=surcharge_cents, currency='usd', payment_method=payment_method_id, confirm=True, metadata={'shipment_id': shipment_id, 'reason': 'reroute'})
    _cancel_pending_reroutes(shipment_id)
    resp = requests.post(f'{CARRIER_API}/shipments/{shipment_id}/reroute', json={'address': new_address}, timeout=15)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    result = {'shipment_id': shipment_id, 'new_address': new_address, 'charge_id': charge.id, 'charge_status': charge.status, 'carrier_status': resp.json().get('status')}
    return result
